name: Annotated Narrative Interlocutor Text Archive (ANITA)
description: Speaker Attribution in Fiction is an important task in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), and recently has been changed radically with the advent of Large Language Models (LLM’s). In this work we introduce a new dataset, the Annotated Narrative Interlocutor Text Archive, or ANITA, derived from 25 Project Gutenberg books to nearly double the size of the leading Speaker Attribution dataset. Additionally, we evaluate the performance of various Large Language Models (LLMs) and training regimens on this task, and highlight interesting challenges in traditional methods of post-training for this task, coming to the conclusion that Speaker Attribution functions as an interesting new benchmark for mixed-difficulty tasks which only slightly correlate with model size and traditional metrics of model cognition.
